brief:
Protest movements targeting multinational corporations emerged across Pakistan, Britain, and Turkey, Shehab Wire reported. Demonstrators are demanding consumer boycotts of companies they accuse of maintaining ties to Israel or profiting from weapons-related investments linked to the occupation.

The coordinated actions represent a significant expansion of grassroots pressure on major businesses perceived as benefiting from or directly supporting Israeli interests. Activists in major cities have launched public campaigns highlighting alleged corporate connections to Israeli military industries and settlement expansion, seeking to leverage consumer power as a tool for economic pressure against companies operating across multiple continents.
